Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.body:
Dear colleagues at Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG,

Thank you for your letter and for setting out your position.

By the figures you gave us - LCI-C +2.7% at 30% of your cost, PPI-C241 +6.5% at 24% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.4%, not the 9.5% you ask for. Your letter gives us only 51 days of notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01, ctr:4600070110). Our contract requires 90 days. The German labour cost index for manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

The data does not support your price as it stands; the options below follow from it.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 132.20 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 130.49 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 130.91 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We are happy to go through the figures together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We prefer to build on your Option B, maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
